annotations.title: Value a mobile home park on its lot rent

description: Runs the Pad Count lot-rent valuation worksheet: from pads, occupancy, lot rent, park-owned homes, other income and expenses it returns collected income, operating expenses, NOI, NOI from lots alone, value at the low, middle and high of a cap rate range the user supplies, value per pad, and the lender flags (85% occupancy, park-owned home share against the 25%/35% agency caps, pad minimums, Fannie Mae 5% economic vacancy floor, park-paid utilities).

admin_legal_other.description: Admin, legal and other expenses per year. Default 0.

bad_debt_pct.description: Bad debt and concessions, percent of gross income. Default 0.

cap_rate_high_pct.description: High end of the cap rate range in percent, e.g. 8.5.

cap_rate_low_pct.description: Low end of the cap rate range in percent, e.g. 7. No public source publishes park cap rates; use what brokers who sell parks in the area quote.

home_rent_monthly.description: Home rent a renter pays on top of lot rent, dollars per month. Default 0.

insurance.description: Insurance per year in dollars. Default 0.

lot_rent_monthly.description: Lot rent per pad per month in dollars, e.g. 450.

management_pct.description: Management as a percent of collected income. Default 0; a buyer counts it even when the owner self-manages.

occupied_pads.description: Pads with a home paying rent, including rented park-owned homes, e.g. 68.

other_income_monthly.description: Late fees, laundry, storage, per month in dollars. Default 0.

park_owned_home_costs.description: Repairs, turnover and any tax on the park-owned homes, per year. Default 0.

park_owned_homes.description: Every home the park, the owner or an affiliate owns, rented or not. Default 0.

park_owned_homes_rented.description: Of those, how many are rented now. Default 0.

payroll.description: Payroll and on-site manager per year. Default 0.

property_taxes.description: Property taxes per year in dollars. Default 0.

repairs_roads_grounds.description: Repairs, roads and grounds per year. Default 0.

reserves_per_pad.description: Reserves per pad per year. Default 50, Freddie Mac's minimum.

reserves_per_park_owned_home.description: Reserves per park-owned home per year. Default 250, the figure Freddie Mac's Guide uses.

utilities_park_pays.description: Water, sewer, trash and common-area electric the park pays, per year. Default 0.

utility_bill_backs_monthly.description: Utility bill-backs collected per month in dollars (counted only when water_sewer is billed_back). Default 0.

water_sewer.description: billed_back (submetered, billed to residents), park_pays (included in lot rent) or resident_direct. Default billed_back.

name: value_park_on_lot_rent
title: Value a mobile home park on its lot rent
